approvalEvidenceSchema.reviewedByRule: must identify an independent reviewer or independent review function
approvalEvidenceSchema.humanApproverRule: must identify a human approver distinct from the independent review control
approvalEvidenceSchema.reviewedDigestRule: must equal the SHA-256 digest of the released source and repository evidence files
approvalEvidenceSchema.evidenceRule: every required control must be explicitly attested true and supported by at least one regular repository evidence file
